name: AB-001
summary: AB-001 (1-pentyl-3-(1-adamantoyl)indole) is a designer drug that was found as an ingredient in synthetic cannabis smoking blends in Ireland in 2010 and Hungary and Germany in 2011.

pharmacology.text: It is unclear who AB-001 was originally developed by, but it is structurally related to compounds such as AM-1248 and its corresponding 1-(tetrahydropyran-4-ylmethyl) analogue, which are known to be potent cannabinoid agonists with moderate to a high selectivity for CB2 over CB1.

uses.text: AB-001 (1-pentyl-3-(1-adamantoyl)indole) is a designer drug that was found as an ingredient in synthetic cannabis smoking blends in Ireland in 2010 and Hungary and Germany in 2011.

summaryZh: AB-001（化學名：1-戊基-3-(1-金剛烷甲醯基)吲哚，1-pentyl-3-indole）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C24H31NO，屬於大麻素類狡詐家藥物，2010年在愛爾蘭，2011年在德國和匈牙利發現，結構上與AM-1248類似。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, anxiety, paranoia and confusion. They are far more dangerous than cannabis, with reports of seizures, psychosis, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、焦慮、多疑與意識混亂。它們比大麻危險得多，曾有癲癇發作、精神病、腎損傷、心臟病發作與死亡的報告，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、焦虑、多疑与意识混乱。它们比大麻危险得多，曾有癫痫发作、精神病、肾损伤、心脏病发作与死亡的报告，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: Its bulky adamantane group is a cage of ten carbon atoms arranged exactly as they are in diamond. The same cage appears in the antiviral drug amantadine.
fact.zh: 它龐大的金剛烷基團是由十個碳原子組成的籠狀結構，排列方式與鑽石完全相同。同樣的籠狀結構也出現在抗病毒藥金剛胺（amantadine）中。
fact.zhHans: 它庞大的金刚烷基团是由十个碳原子组成的笼状结构，排列方式与钻石完全相同。同样的笼状结构也出现在抗病毒药金刚胺（amantadine）中。
